description.p: LimeLight is a lightweight controller for Elgato Key Light, Key Light Air, Key Light Mini, Ring Light and Light Strip devices on Linux. It finds lights on your LAN and lets you control power, brightness and colour temperature, individually, in groups, or all at once, without the bloat.
A small local daemon talks to the lights and exposes a localhost HTTP API so you can build your own integrations. An OpenDeck (Stream Deck) plugin is available separately.
All Lights and group sliders act as master controls. Preset highlights and sliders always reflect real light levels. The window restarts the daemon if it stops.
Presets: save a look from any light or group, apply it with one tap, manage them in Settings. Slider drags no longer scroll the page. OpenDeck plugin link.

Per-light settings (name, power-on behaviour, fade durations, identify). Lights switch together instead of one after another. Offline lights stay visible and come back on their own. Renames and IP changes are tracked automatically. Start-on-login fixed. Much smaller daemon.
Slint GUI (LimeLight) replaces tray app; taskbar icon fix, manage lights/groups, settings, autostart.
